title: Code-Switching Information Retrieval: Benchmarks Analysis and the Limits of Current Retrievers
authors: Qingcheng Zeng; Yuheng Lu; Zeqi Zhou; Heli Qi; Puxuan Yu; Fuheng Zhao; Hitomi Yanaka; Weihao Xuan; Naoto Yokoya
signals_or_features: embedding divergence; performance degradation
notes: Directly establishes the current code-switching IR problem and evaluates multiple retriever families; no selector proposed.

title: QuDAR: Query-Wise Dual-Perspective Adaptive Retrieval
authors: Joeun Kim; Seunghyouk Yoon; Xuan-Bach Le; Youngeun Nam; Doyoung Kim; Hwanjun Song; Jae-Gil Lee
retrievers: sparse; dense; original and expanded query views
signals_or_features: top-1 minus top-2 margin; blind LLM relevance; query representation
notes: Direct collision with margin/confidence-based sparse/dense weighting and query-wise adaptation.

title: Query-Adaptive Hybrid Search
authors: Pavel Posokhov; Stepan Skrylnikov; Sergei Masliukhin; Alina Zavgorodniaia; Olesia Koroteeva; Yuri Matveev
signals_or_features: query latent representation; antagonist negatives; alpha bins
notes: Uses BM25, query-driven alpha prediction and complementarity-aware training; makes adaptive alpha a directly covered mechanism.

title: When Does Mixing Help? Analyzing Query Embedding Interpolation in Multilingual Dense Retrieval
authors: Tongyao Zhu; Huang Chao Ming; Min-Yen Kan
retrievers: dense BGE-M3 and other dense models
signals_or_features: embedding-level mixing ratio; language dominance; typological distance
notes: Shows that language-mix sensitivity and mixing-ratio effects are structured and predictable, weakening structure-only novelty.

title: MoR: Better Handling Diverse Queries with a Mixture of Sparse Dense and Human Retrievers
authors: Jushaan Singh Kalra; Xinran Zhao; To Eun Kim; Fengyu Cai; Fernando Diaz; Tongshuang Wu
retrievers: BM25; multiple dense; human ranked sources
signals_or_features: retriever/query/document interaction; geometric weighting
datasets: NFCorpus; SciDocs; SciFact; SciQ; simulated humans
notes: Direct prior for per-query complementarity analysis, oracle routing and mixture weighting.

title: RouterRetriever: Routing over a Mixture of Expert Embedding Models
authors: Hyunji Lee; Luca Soldaini; Arman Cohan; Minjoon Seo; Kyle Lo
retrievers: base dense plus domain-specific LoRA experts
signals_or_features: pilot embeddings; similarity to expert centroids
notes: Generic query-to-retriever routing is established even without code-switching.

title: RAGRouter: Learning to Route Queries to Multiple Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
authors: Jiarui Zhang; Xiangyu Liu; Yong Hu; Chaoyue Niu; Fan Wu; Guihai Chen
signals_or_features: document embeddings; RAG capability embeddings; score threshold
notes: Adjacent direct prior for query routing with retrieval-dependent capability and efficiency thresholds.

title: Adaptive Retrieval Without Self-Knowledge? Bringing Uncertainty Back Home
authors: Viktor Moskvoretskii; Maria Marina; Mikhail Salnikov; Nikolay Ivanov; Sergey Pletenev; Daria Galimzianova; Nikita Krayko; Vasily Konovalov; Irina Nikishina; Alexander Panchenko
signals_or_features: uncertainty estimators; external and internal signals
notes: Reviews 35 adaptive retrieval and uncertainty methods and finds lightweight uncertainty competitive with complex pipelines.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Estimation of Source Reliability
authors: Jeongyeon Hwang; Junyoung Park; Hyejin Park; Dongwoo Kim; Sangdon Park; Jungseul Ok
signals_or_features: cross-source agreement; estimated source reliability
notes: Direct prior for source reliability estimation, selective retrieval and risk-aware aggregation; target differs from sparse/dense rank choice.

title: Controlling Risk of Retrieval-augmented Generation: A Counterfactual Prompting Framework
authors: Lu Chen; Ruqing Zhang; Jiafeng Guo; Yixing Fan; Xueqi Cheng
signals_or_features: retrieved-result quality; answer utilization; confidence
datasets: RC-RAG benchmark and public QA datasets
notes: Establishes risk-aware abstention and evaluation of retrieval-induced uncertainty, but not retriever selection.

title: When to Speak When to Abstain: Contrastive Decoding with Abstention
authors: Hyuhng Joon Kim; Youna Kim; Sang-goo Lee; Taeuk Kim
signals_or_features: relative relevance of internal and external knowledge
notes: Directly shows training-free selective source choice and abstention are active, though downstream task is generation.

title: ContrastiveMix: Overcoming Code-Mixing Dilemma in Cross-Lingual Transfer for Information Retrieval
authors: Junggeun Do; Jaeseong Lee; Seung-won Hwang
retrievers: mDPR-style dense plus BM25 hybrid baseline
signals_or_features: code-mixed query representation alignment; linguistic similarity
notes: Direct code-mixed IR adaptation and sparse-dense baseline; no inference-only selector.

title: Boosting Zero-shot Cross-lingual Retrieval by Training on Artificially Code-Switched Data
authors: Robert Litschko; Ekaterina Artemova; Barbara Plank
signals_or_features: mixing ratio in generated training data
notes: Establishes code-switched training as a retrieval adaptation strategy, not runtime relative reliability.

title: Improving Cross-lingual Representation for Semantic Retrieval with Code-switching
authors: Mieradilijiang Maimaiti; Yuanhang Zheng; Ji Zhang; Yue Zhang; Wenpei Luo; Kaiyu Huang
signals_or_features: bilingual-dictionary-generated code switching; XMLM and similarity loss
datasets: three business corpora and four open datasets
notes: Direct representation-learning prior; no sparse/dense choice.

title: Code-Mixed Probes Show How Pre-Trained Models Generalise on Code-Switched Text
authors: Frances Adriana Laureano De Leon; Harish Tayyar Madabushi; Mark Lee
signals_or_features: switch structure; structural information; representation consistency
datasets: naturalistic code-switched corpus with parallel translations
notes: Shows structural probing and representation effects are established, even outside retrieval.

title: Relevant for the Right Reasons? Investigating Lexical Biases in Zero-Shot and Instruction-Tuned Rerankers
authors: Yuchen Mao; Barbara Plank; Robert Litschko
method_family: code-switched instruction tuning and lexical-bias analysis
signals_or_features: lexical overlap; counterfactual keyword rewrites
notes: Shows code-switched reranking and lexical-bias diagnostics; no sparse/dense route.

title: Findings of the Code-Mixed Information Retrieval from Social Media Data Shared Task at FIRE 2025
authors: Supriya Chanda; Krishna Tewari; Sukomal Pal
signals_or_features: varied per-system features; one meta-learner
notes: Current shared-task evidence for hybrid, reranking, fusion and complementarity in code-mixed IR.

title: Model Fusion for Bridging Linguistic Variability in Bengali-English Code-Mixed Information Retrieval
authors: Rachana Nagaraju; Hosahalli Lakshmaiah Shashirekha
signals_or_features: lexical and language-variation handling
notes: Direct precedent for using complementary rankers for code-mixed search.

title: LexiSemIR: A Two-Stage Re-ranking Framework with BM25 and Zero-Shot Bi-Encoder
authors: Swati Gupta; Tanusree Nath; Vedika Gupta; Manjari Gupta
method_family: lexical candidate retrieval plus dense reranking
signals_or_features: fixed two-stage pipeline
notes: Direct BM25-plus-dense code-mixed retrieval precedent.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion Based Hybrid Dense-Sparse Information Retrieval on Code-Mixed Banglish Social Media Text
authors: Burhanuddin Merchant; Ashwaq Khazi; Sheetal S. Sonawane
signals_or_features: fixed fusion
notes: Especially direct code-mixed BM25-dense-RRF prior.

title: Decoding Benglish: Scalable Information Retrieval for Transliterated Code-Mixed Conversations
authors: Harsh Mishra; Ramya Sharma; Naina Yadav
signals_or_features: transliteration and script handling
notes: Directly blocks a generic claim that BM25 plus dense retrieval for code-mixed queries is new.

title: Design and Evaluation of a Code-Switching-Aware Multilingual Conversational AI System using Advanced RAG Architectures
authors: Ashutosh Juvale
signals_or_features: CMI; matrix language; language profile
notes: Thesis-level prior against CMI or matrix-language routing as a standalone novelty claim.

title: Predicting Efficiency Effectiveness Trade-offs for Dense vs Sparse Retrieval Strategy Selection
authors: Negar Arabzadeh; Xinyi Yan; Charles L. A. Clarke
signals_or_features: query features; outcome-derived strategy labels
notes: Direct prior for query-level sparse-dense-hybrid selection.

title: Selecting which Dense Retriever to use for Zero-Shot Search
authors: Ekaterina Khramtsova; Shengyao Zhuang; Mahsa Baktashmotlagh; Xi Wang; Guido Zuccon
signals_or_features: query-corpus similarity; corpus similarity; document similarity; entropy
notes: Shows retriever selection is a named IR problem and unsupervised signals may fail under shift.

title: Leveraging LLMs for Unsupervised Dense Retriever Ranking
authors: Ekaterina Khramtsova; Shengyao Zhuang; Mahsa Baktashmotlagh; Guido Zuccon
signals_or_features: LLM-generated queries; pseudo-relevant labels and reference lists
notes: Direct zero-label model-selection precedent, usually corpus-level rather than per-query.

title: Query Performance Prediction for Neural IR: Are We There Yet?
authors: Guglielmo Faggioli; Thibault Formal; Stefano Marchesin; Stéphane Clinchant; Nicola Ferro; Benjamin Piwowarski
signals_or_features: nineteen QPP predictors; score and lexical features
notes: Finds QPP performs worse on neural systems and fails most where neural and lexical rankings differ.

title: Coherence-based Query Performance Measures for Dense Retrieval
authors: Maria Vlachou; Craig Macdonald
signals_or_features: embedding coherence; score distributions; query type
notes: Directly covers unlabeled dense post-retrieval predictors and their instability by query type.

title: Can we predict QPP? An approach based on multivariate outliers
authors: Adrian-Gabriel Chifu; Sébastien Déjean; Moncef Garouani; Josiane Mothe; Diego Ortiz; Md Zia Ullah
signals_or_features: multivariate outlier detection; hard-to-predict queries
notes: Shows selective treatment of difficult-to-predict queries is already part of QPP research.

title: Query Performance Prediction Using Relevance Judgments Generated by Large Language Models
authors: Chuan Meng; Negar Arabzadeh; Arian Askari; Mohammad Aliannejadi; Maarten de Rijke
signals_or_features: item-level pseudo-relevance judgments; metric-specific prediction
notes: Modern QPP directly estimates ranker quality without human labels and supports downstream selective decisions.

title: Uncovering the Limitations of Query Performance Prediction: Failures Insights and Implications for Selective Query Processing
authors: Adrian-Gabriel Chifu; Sébastien Déjean; Josiane Mothe; Moncef Garouani; Diego Ortiz; Md Zia Ullah
task: QPP robustness and selective query processing
signals_or_features: NQC; UQC; LETOR; dense predictors; cross-collection variability
notes: Reports collection/ranker-dependent QPP and only marginal gains from QPP-driven selective processing.

title: Tasks Queries and Rankers in Pre-Retrieval Performance Prediction
authors: Paul Thomas; Falk Scholer; Peter Bailey; Alistair Moffat
signals_or_features: task difficulty; query wording; ranker effects
notes: Classic warning that predictors may capture task difficulty rather than query or ranker reliability.

title: The Art of Abstention: Selective Prediction and Error Regularization for Natural Language Processing
authors: Ji Xin; Raphael Tang; Yaoliang Yu; Jimmy Lin
signals_or_features: confidence estimators; error regularization
notes: Establishes risk-coverage and confidence-based abstention in NLP; not retrieval-specific.

title: Selective Selective Prediction: Reducing Unnecessary Abstention in Vision-Language Reasoning
authors: Tejas Srinivasan; Jack Hessel; Tanmay Gupta; Bill Yuchen Lin; Yejin Choi; Jesse Thomason; Khyathi Chandu
signals_or_features: low-confidence evidence collection; coverage-risk tradeoff
notes: Demonstrates asymmetric concern about over-abstention and risk-preserving coverage, adjacent to retrieval abstention.

title: Knowledge Graph Guided Evaluation of Abstention Techniques
authors: Kinshuk Vasisht; Navreet Kaur; Danish Pruthi
signals_or_features: concept specificity; descendant generalization; abstention rate
notes: Shows abstention methods trade generalization against specificity and no single method dominates.

title: The Craft of Selective Prediction: Towards Reliable Case Outcome Classification
authors: Santosh T.Y.S.S; Irtiza Chowdhury; Shanshan Xu; Matthias Grabmair
signals_or_features: softmax; MC dropout; error regularization
notes: Empirical selective-risk study emphasizing calibration, overconfidence and coverage-risk curves.

title: Do LLMs Know When to NOT Answer? Investigating Abstention Abilities of Large Language Models
authors: Nishanth Madhusudhan; Sathwik Tejaswi Madhusudhan; Vikas Yadav; Masoud Hashemi
signals_or_features: verbal confidence; strict prompting; AUCM
notes: Black-box abstention evaluation shows confidence and refusal behavior are difficult to calibrate.
